focus: Fail-closed separation of Hostinger research evidence from final Andreas Ubuntu target acceptance.
name: COUNTERFEIT_TARGET_RECEIPT_ATTACK
method: Construct otherwise-complete synthetic receipts with all required work packages and ten applications marked pass, then vary only target/CI provenance and apply a minimal contract-derived fail-closed adjudication shadow.
interpretation: Hostinger success must never be promotable to final target acceptance by merely copying a target_host label; execution-context checks are independently required.
strongest_counterhypothesis: This local adjudication shadow is not the repository's future strict adjudicator and cannot prove the eventual implementation will enforce every hard rule. The actual target collector/strict receipt artifacts are currently absent and remain implementation obligations.
test_obligation: When the Andreas Ubuntu strict adjudicator is implemented, include these counterfeit cases plus missing-field, stale-hash, proxy-only, unresolved-counterexample and semantic-escape-hatch negatives as mandatory regression fixtures.
